Alex: Heads-up :rotating_light: nightly eval run flagged multiple regressions across suites. Top offenders: summarization-suite (high impact), prompt-robustness (medium), codegen-smoke (low). Initial severity: summarization -> P1, prompt-robustness -> P2, codegen-smoke -> P3. Artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/1713501234/. Please claim ownership for quick triage.

CI-Bot: nightly-eval v2026-04-17 06:12 UTC results summary:
 - summarization-suite: pass 82% -> 61% (delta -21pp)
 - prompt-robustness: pass 93% -> 76% (delta -17pp)
 - codegen-smoke: pass 98% -> 94% (delta -4pp)
Failing model variant: redwood-model-v2-q4_0 (quantized). Baseline: redwood-model-v2-fp16. Full artifact bundle: https://s3.redwood/1713501234/index.html

Monica: I'll take summarization (P1) — starting reproducer locally and will sample 50 failing prompts. @Saurabh can you look at q4 variants? Might be quantization-specific.

Saurabh: Copy. Quick heads-up: q4_0 has shown occasional token-shift/eos-placement issues before, especially on longer contexts (>1024). I'll run a logits diff against fp16 and check kv-cache alignment.

Alex: Triage checklist (short):
 - reproduce top 50 failures with same seed / sampling config
 - compare outputs to fp16 baseline (diff top k tokens & logits)
 - check prompt normalization/tokenization edge cases
 - check decoding params (temp, top_p) and sampler changes
 - look for common pattern (hallucination, truncation, extra clauses)

Monica: Reproducer done; 50 samples pulled. Early skim: ~36/50 show the model appending an unrelated sentence starting with 'However'. Attaching one example below.

Monica: ````
PROMPT-ID: prompt-9832
PROMPT: "Summarize the main findings of the cardiovascular study and list limitations."
BASELINE (fp16): "The study shows a 12% reduction in risk; limitations include sample size and short follow-up."
Q4_0 (regressed): "The study shows a 12% reduction in risk. However, the team also noted increased attendance at community events unrelated to the study which may bias results."
ERROR PATTERN: insertion of unrelated sentence; numeric facts preserved but extra clause hallucinated.
````

Saurabh: That pattern matches a decoding/post-processing shift — could be rounding noise in logits causing different beam/penalty interplay. I'll diff logits for that prompt and a couple others. If logits deltas concentrate around end-of-sequence tokens, kv cache misalignment is suspect.

Julien: Also recommend running an embedding-drift check: compute mean embedding cosine between baseline and q4_0 across the failing set. If semantic drift > .05 mean, that's actionable. I can spin that up and post histograms.

Tasha: Given P1 for summarization, propose two parallel tracks: (A) fast mitigation: roll quantized variant back from production canary (if served) -> immediate rollback if canary traffic shows same errors, (B) deeper triage with owners. Owners: Monica (summarization triage + issue), Saurabh (quant/kernel investigation), Julien (embedding drift + eval delta). Target: decide on rollback within 24h.

Monica: Opening internal issue now: RED-ML-2026-409. Attaching reproducer, 50 failing prompts, top 10 diffs, and raw generations. Will update issue with first-pass hypothesis by EOD.

Saurabh: Running kernel/quant sim tests now. Preliminary note: q4_0 uses int4 scale packing that rounds logits differently for tokens with low magnitude — that can flip argmax for tail tokens. Running a deterministic decode with beam size 1 to isolate.

Julien: Embedding diffs queued. If drift concentrated on sentence-final embeddings, that supports the kv/token alignment hypothesis.

Monica: Quick stats from the sampled 50:
 - 36/50 had appended unrelated clause
 - 8/50 had premature truncation
 - 6/50 matched baseline
Pattern suggests decoding/post-logit perturbation rather than dataset/prompt change.

Alex: Good. Action items recap: 
 - Monica: file + reproduce + sample artifacts (RED-ML-2026-409) [owner, P1]
 - Saurabh: logits diff, kv-cache alignment, quant-sim tests [owner]
 - Julien: embedding drift histograms + delta-eval [owner]
 - Tasha/Infra: standby to rollback q4_0 canary if we confirm production hits or deterministic repro reproduces on canary config [ops]

Monica: I'll mark the issue P1 and add a short runbook for rollback steps if needed. Posting link to issue: https://redwood/issue/RED-ML-2026-409

CI-Bot: note: canary pool currently serving q4_0 to 5% traffic in us-west. Recommend pausing traffic if deterministic repros match.

Tasha: I'll coordinate with infra to hold a potential rollback window tonight 22:00 UTC.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Please update the issue with earliest reproducible prompt IDs and top-5 token-logit diffs. We'll reconvene in this thread in 3 hrs for status. :thumbsup:
